channels.name: SCLK
channels.purpose: Serial clock supplied by the active master.

channels.name: SDATA
channels.purpose: Serial data (command/address/data frames, MSB-first, odd parity).
channels.active_levels: driven by master or slave per phase

handshake_pairs.name: SSC / sequence detect
handshake_pairs.rule: All devices detect the Sequence Start Condition to synchronize on a new transaction.

handshake_pairs.name: Frame / parity
handshake_pairs.rule: Each frame is MSB-first with an odd parity bit; a mismatch makes the receiver ignore the frame.

handshake_pairs.name: Arbitration / Request
handshake_pairs.rule: (SPMI) higher priority / lower MASTER_ID wins; a slave Request flags need for service.

handshake_pairs.name: Trigger / apply
handshake_pairs.rule: A Trigger event applies pre-loaded trigger-register values simultaneously.

handshake_pairs.name: Interrupt / clear
handshake_pairs.rule: Slave raises an interrupt; master Interrupt-Reads and clears.

dependency_graph.common_rule: All devices share SCLK/SDATA; a transaction is framed by an SSC and a Bus Park Cycle; frames are MSB-first with odd parity. Slave selection is by 4-bit ID inside the Command Frame.
dependency_graph.data_dependency: A valid transaction requires: (1) bus idle / arbitration won (SPMI), (2) a valid SSC, (3) correct parity on every frame. RFFE triggered writes depend on a subsequent Trigger event; SPMI power-state changes depend on the targeted SLAVE_ID/Group Sub-ID.

ufm_channels.name: USDA
ufm_channels.purpose: Ultra Fast-mode serial data. Push-pull, unidirectional (master-to-slave only). No ACK; the 9th SCL pulse drives SDA HIGH ignoring response.

ufm_channels.name: USCL
ufm_channels.purpose: Ultra Fast-mode serial clock. Push-pull, unidirectional. Master drives all clock pulses; no clock stretching.

ordering_rules.transaction_atomicity: One transaction at a time on the shared bus; SPMI arbitration serializes masters; RFFE triggers defer application to a common Trigger event.
